target.statement: Final global clustering coefficient C > 0.5 for the entropy-driven rewiring model at (q=0.9, r=0.9, beta=128), N=100, K=4 ring lattice, T=3e6, theta=100, averaged over 10 trials
target.table_ref: Fig. 2a (heatmap cell at q=0.9, r=0.9, beta=128)
target.dataset: synthetic Quoter-model simulation (Zipf vocabulary z=1000, alpha=1.5; Poisson text length lambda=3)

compute.basis: No code released; the agent must reimplement the Quoter model, the O(t^2) match-length cross-entropy estimator (paper cites a C++ implementation [24] but does not link it), softmax rewiring, and Louvain metrics, then run T=3e6 timesteps x 10 trials for one (q,r,beta) cell; the full heatmap is 21x21x8 parameter sets x 10 trials, which is far beyond a few hours on 8 CPU cores.

blockers: cross-entropy match-length estimator must be reimplemented (cited C++ tool not linked)
T=3e6 timesteps x 10 trials per cell is heavy for pure Python; needs optimized C/C++ or vectorized implementation
full parameter sweep (q,r in 21 values, beta in 8 values, 10 trials) is infeasible in a few hours
title: An Information-Theoretic Model for the Evolution of a Social Network
